data.body: CI/Ubuntu after-measurement (change 2043, Verified run 32544155379, merged): the test no longer appears in ANY of the four pytest matrix jobs' slowest-25 durations lists — it dropped below each job's 25th-slowest floor (ubuntu py3.11 floor 15.62s in that run; the other jobs' floors 12.26-14.88s). Before: 12.79/14.54/14.93s ubuntu + 15.34s macos (run 32296354188, recorded on afa0-2e15), i.e. it was the largest variable default-suite node; after: below the durations-report cutoff on every job, consistent with the local 17.03s -> 2.9-3.4s scaling (~57.6s -> under ~12s aggregate runner time per change, most of the residue fixture overhead). All AC met: F2 3/3, F3 5/5, F4 3/3, F6 5/5 RED at 1 round; F1/F5/F7 column unchanged; assertions untouched, test retained; 10/10 unseeded GREEN.
